topic: How to handle technical test anxiety during developer interviews

post.topic: How to handle technical test anxiety during developer interviews
post.linkedin_text:
Live coding interviews make even experienced developers freeze up.

It is rarely about your actual coding ability.

It is usually about the pressure of performing live under a microscope.

Here is how I learned to stay calm and pass technical tests:

• Talk through your logic before writing any code
• Start with a naive working solution, then optimize
• Treat the interviewer like a teammate, not an examiner

Communication matters much more than getting the syntax 100 percent right on the first try.

How do you usually handle live coding tests?

#SoftwareEngineering #InterviewTips #WebDevelopment #CareerGrowth

slides.title: How to *survive* live coding interviews
slides.body: Stop letting interview anxiety ruin your technical tests.

slides.title: Talk out loud constantly
slides.body: Your interviewer cannot read your mind. Explaining your thought process shows problem-solving skills even if you get stuck.

slides.title: Build the brute force first
slides.body: Do not optimize prematurely. Write a working naive solution first, then talk about how to make it more efficient.

slides.title: Ask clarifying questions
slides.body: Never jump straight into coding. Confirm edge cases, expected input sizes, and constraints to show engineering maturity.
